text:
maddie.ops: Heads up — multiple customer reports of 504/timeout spikes starting ~10:12 UTC. Traces show long queue times at gateway and backend errors while pods were scaling. Can we triage? :eyes:
jonah.eng: on it. pulling keda and hpa metrics now. initial look: ScaledObject didn't kick fast enough for a tenant burst, scaled from 0 -> 1 in ~95s.
priya-support: Customer IDs: CUST-7881, CUST-1902. They saw 20s+ waits then gateway 504s. They repro'd by hitting the API in a burst.
alex-oncall: seeing gateway logs: upstream request timeout after 15s, then 502/504. Backend logs show model runtime container stuck in Init for ~1.5m for some pods. Also some 403s from object-store during model fetch (retrying).
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8472. Pager notified @oncall.
maddie.ops: repro steps I used: scale down, send burst, observe queue backlog
```
kubectl scale deployment ml-runtime -n prod --replicas=0
ab -n 300 -c 60 https://api.redwood-inference.net/v1/generate
```
jonah.eng: notes: KEDA config for this ScaledObject has pollInterval: 30 and cooldownPeriod: 180. With model-init times >60s and storage fetch retries, detection + cooldown means pods stay at 0 too long. Also no prewarm config on this tenant.
priya-support: customer is on Dedicated plan and expects low tail latency. They're escalating because their UI timed out and they lost revenue.
alex-oncall: mitigation applied: bumped gateway upstream timeout to 60s to reduce 502s while we scale, rerouted heavy tenants to warm model-variant where init is faster, and temporarily set minReplica=1 for CUST-7881.
maddie.ops: quick patch I applied to KEDA to speed detection (temp):
```
kubectl patch scaledobject ml-runtime-scaledobject -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/pollingInterval","value":5},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/cooldownPeriod","value":30}]'
```
jonah.eng: thanks, that lowered scale-up from ~95s to ~22s in canary. Long term we should: enable a prewarm hook for model variants with slow init, add a minReplica for dedicated high-SLA tenants, and track model-fetch failure rates as a signal (403/5xx from object store).
kevin-cs: Customer agreed to routing to warm variant — they reported improved responsiveness. They want a postmortem and guarantee this won't repeat.
priya-support: action items for support: contact customers with timeline, rollback notes, and ETA for fixes. Also ask customers for any non-prod traffic patterns that trigger bursts.
alex-oncall: root cause summary: combination of (1) KEDA pollInterval/cooldown tuned for CPU-based loads, not model-init latency, (2) model fetch retries and transient 403s delaying pod readiness, and (3) no prewarm/minReplica for the affected tenant. Result: scale-up lag -> gateway queue overflow -> 504s/502s.
maddie.ops: filed follow-ups: add default prewarm for prod tenants, add scaledobject tuning per workload, emit a kpi when scaledobject detection lag > 30s, and add runbook steps for immediate mitigation (increase gateway timeout, route to warm variant, set minReplica). PR: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/infra/4563 (WIP).
jonah.eng: also opened an infra ticket to add a model-fetch preflight check in the control plane so we fail fast on auth/403 and avoid long init retries.
priya-support: closing loop with customers now. Please post postmortem draft here when ready. :thumbsup:
maddie.ops: will draft postmortem and schedule follow-up post-incident review. Adding owners: @jonah.eng for infra change, @alex-oncall for runbook updates, @priya-support for customer comms.
